what_it_actually_does: Looks for a StaticMeshActor whose name contains 'Road' or 'Roads' (line 359-368).
If found and the map is tiled, ApplyRoadPainterMaterials spawns DecalActors whose materials come from roadpainter_decals.json (line 125-264).
what_it_does_NOT_do: It never touches StaticMesh material slots.
It contains no SetMaterial, no OverrideMaterials, no StaticMaterials iteration.
It contains no reference to any MAT_ asset.
It never assigns materials to StaticMeshComponents.

package_json_for_ingolstadt.note: Only the MAIN world is listed. The 20 tile worlds are NOT listed, so this commandlet never visits them.

uses_carla_materials_flag: Parsed into FMapData::bUseCarlaMapMaterials (line 424) but never read anywhere in this commandlet. Dead in this class.
